'''Dindo''', also known as '''Lefty''', was a criminal who was captured by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]], apparently by [[Hal Horn|Hal]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]. He tried to cut through his binders with a [[molecular stiletto]] and accidentally harmed himself.<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>
